name: Zoltán Kiss
bio:
Zoltán's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years in advertising, he found himself captivated by the raw energy and precision of a local rally event. This sparked a career pivot, leading him to leverage his marketing expertise within the racing world. He believes in crafting narratives that resonate with fans on a personal level, moving beyond simple sponsorship announcements to build genuine connections. 

At EVO Racing Team, Zoltán focuses on data-driven strategies to maximize brand visibility and engagement. He is a staunch advocate for utilizing digital platforms to cultivate a loyal fanbase and boost team revenue. While comfortable working independently, he values collaboration and is always eager to learn from his colleagues' diverse experiences.

What sets Zoltán apart is his ability to blend traditional marketing principles with a modern, forward-thinking approach. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and is constantly seeking innovative ways to elevate EVO Racing Team's profile in the highly competitive motorsport landscape.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Zoltán is a man of medium build with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even in meetings.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in his office.
Insists on brewing his own strong coffee every morning.
